metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code mods by Xavier Yen that use function hooks to draw in the band above the prompt.

plugins.name: retrovis-mod
plugins.description: A classic media-player visualizer above the prompt: a plasma field with equalizer bars and peak markers, or cats mode, a row of pixel cats dancing on a rooftop in the outfit you pick. The session is the music: prompts, tool calls and turns kick the bars, brighten the plasma and set the cats bobbing. Needs function hooks and an interactive terminal, and costs zero model tokens.
